ModMetadata.Name: Serial Terminal
ModMetadata.Author: etareduction
ModMetadata.Description:
Adds the Norsec TTY-6 Serial Terminal: a wall-mounted glass teletype your IC10 circuits can print to and read typed input from, through a classic memory-mapped UART (get/put). Click the screen to type.
IC10 quick reference (device d0): put d0 0 char - print one ASCII character put d0 1 str - print a packed string, e.g. put d0 1 STR("HELLO ") get r0 d0 0 - pop next typed character (0 if none) get r0 d0 2 - characters waiting put d0 3 1 - clear screen Logic: Setting (write packed string), Quantity (input waiting), Error (input overflow), Mode (Echo/Silent), Color.
